title: Held-out examples run only in judgment
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0103 no longer matches the current design.
decision: A held-out example is run only in judgment, never during the build. When it fails in judgment it becomes visible, and the illustrator writes a cold replacement for the next judgment.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
